<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Get all dashboards</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"get"} path={"/perses-public/api/v1/dashboards"}></MethodEndpoint>



Returns the latest version of every dashboard in the account, across all folders.

Dashboards that were made private in the Logz.io app are returned only to an API token with admin permissions. For any other token they are left out of the response.


## Request
